title: Contract publishes no audit trail of cumulative rewards distributed vs funded, breaking the linear-depletion intent verifiability and enabling silent fund mis-routing
rootCause: No `totalRewardsCollected` / `totalRewardsDistributed` aggregates. Combined with DEDUP-001 (asymptotic residue), DEDUP-013 (zero-staked window loss), DEDUP-004 (emergencyTransfer sweep), there is no on-chain way to verify the protocol's headline 'linear depletion' claim.
impactSummary: Accountability gap; complicates funder trust verification and enables hidden value siphoning in combination with DEDUP-001 / DEDUP-004.
preservedDetails: ECON-010 carries the system-level observability gap; DEDUP-020 (CODE-012) is the QA-tip evidence.
remediation: Track immutable accumulators; wire the dead `RateUpdated` event; emit per-update events with the distribution payload.
dedupNotes: Borderline finding — likely demoted to QA bundle but elevated when bundled with DEDUP-004 (emergencyTransfer).
